name: Boss Health Fix
description: Prevents a boss health bar crash that can occur on non-host clients when several bosses die or despawn in quick succession ("Cannot access property current_health_percent on destroyed object of type HuskHealthExtension", since 1.13.3 "Cannot access property boss_is_depleted_interrupter on destroyed object of type BossExtension"). Stale entries are removed before the vanilla boss health bar updates; living bosses and the vanilla bars are unchanged.
author: LucLeto
